text:
Amelia: Heads-up — latency tail for KV-heavy chat requests spiked ~30% after runtime change in commit 12f8a3. Seen on prod-dedicated traces. nsys timelines show kernel stalls around kv_store_lookup + batcher flush.
Raj: can you paste sample p50/p95 and a trace id?
Amelia: p50 42ms -> 46ms, p95 180ms -> 240ms. trace: perf-21436-kv-drift.nsys
Morgan: I grabbed nsys + perfetto for a before/after pair. Before: perf_before_2143.nsys, After: perf_after_2143.nsys. Flame snapshots: flame_before.svg, flame_after.svg
Amelia: attaching command used:
```
nsys profile -o perf_after_2143 --trace=nvtx,cuda --sample=cpu -t 60 ./run_load_test --scenario kv-heavy
```
Raj: seeing long device-to-host memcpy peaks in after trace. Also a 2x kernel launch count for select_kernel_v2.
Sam: did we change kernel selector heuristics in the last PR? IIRC 12f8a3 toggled fallback thresholds.
Morgan: yes, PR 12f8a3 adjusted batcher prefetch window + selector weights
Amelia: I ran quick bisect locally. Repro steps below:
```
git bisect start HEAD HEAD~50
git bisect run ./scripts/bisect_kv_latency.sh
```
Amelia: bisect pointed to 12f8a3 -> selector change triggered kv cache churn
Raj: timeline shows KV cache evictions aligning with memcpy spikes — eviction->repopulate causes extra copies
perf-bot: automated artifact upload: s3://redwood-traces/2143658700/{perf_before,perf_after}.nsys
Sam: hypothesis: changed selector caused smaller batch grouping -> more frequent cache misses and async copies. Try bumping selector_aggregation_threshold back to 0.6 in runtime config and re-run.
Morgan: I ran a config patch: selector_aggregation_threshold=0.6 — latency returned to baseline in my dev replay. GIF: https://files.redwood/quick-replay/2143658700.gif
Amelia: can we patch canary with this config and run 12h tests? If stable, revert 12f8a3 or follow with selector fix.
Raj: +1. I'll open a short-lived revert PR and tag infra to roll a canary.
Amelia: thanks. Next: I'll attach perfetto timelines and a diff of kernel launch histograms.
Amelia: perfetto: https://perfetto.redwood/trace/2143658700
Morgan: added flame SVGs to thread, uploading now.
ci-bot: deploy/canary started for revert-12f8a3 at build #5823
Sam: leaving notes for follow-up: - add KV eviction counters to telemetry - add regression test for batcher prefetch window
Amelia: cool, leaving this thread open until canary is green :thumbsup:
